info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Rotate Secret Management API
info.description: The Rotate Secret Management API facilitates the secure rotation of secrets for webhook endpoints. This API allows businesses to enhance their security posture by regularly updating sensitive information, such as API keys or credentials, thus minimizing risks associated with exposure. Developers and security teams typically consume this API to automate secret rotation processes and ensure that their systems operate with the latest security credentials. This operation is critical for maintaining secure integrations and compliance with security best practices.

post.summary: Rotate the secret for a specified webhook endpoint.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to securely rotate the secret associated with a specific webhook endpoint identified by its resource ID. By calling this operation, you can enhance the security of your application by ensuring that the secrets are regularly updated.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to rotate the secret for the specified webhook endpoint. The request should include all necessary parameters to successfully execute the secret rotation.

200.description: The operation completed successfully, and the secret has been rotated.

RotateWebhookEndpointSecretRequest.description: Request body for rotating a secret in the webhook endpoints operation.
